tips.text: For Evolution III without Mag, stack magazine capacity and multishot, and mod your damage down so the Angel survives all eight headshots.
For Evolution III, Magnetize the woken Void Angel and fire one shot into the bubble; ask a Mag squadmate if you do not play Mag.
Holster the Laetum between Void Angels and never reload; your headshot count carries to the next Angel.
Fill the other Evolution V slots with Incarnon Genesis weapons instead of grinding Holdfasts ranks for more Zariman Incarnons.
Bring loot radar and a wide AoE to break every container, then walk to whichever box your minimap still shows.
Fly the Parallax landing craft and use its Orokin Eye air support; it marks Voidplumes, Accolades and biokeys on your HUD.
Touch the glowing blue orbs so a child runs to the nearest plume; grab that plume first and the spirit picks another.
Finish a bounty objective before you sweep the map; failing the bounty voids every plume you picked up in it.
Getting the gun takes one evening; Evolution III is the only real wall.
